what: the plaintext of a wallet seed backup's one vault object (tier user, one chunk of 1024 bytes, its user wrap in its own header): sealed on the person's device, never seen by the service

fields.name: account
fields.rule: acct_ and 26 characters of a-z2-7: the account the backup was made for

fields.name: entropy
fields.rule: the seed's BIP-39 entropy: 32 or 64 lowercase hex characters

fields.name: epoch
fields.rule: 1 or more; each change to the slots seals the record again at epoch + 1

fields.name: slots
fields.rule: 1 to 8 slot ids (64 lowercase hex characters): every slot that may open this epoch

fields.name: vault
fields.rule: the vault id, 64 lowercase hex characters

slots.passkey_prf_input: SHA-256 of the ASCII bytes openagents.wallet-backup.v1/prf

service.slots: base64 of every slot's text, a newline between them
